observations: Local Bridge interruption was detected by the UI and did not preserve a fabricated authenticated state.
The restarted Local Bridge health endpoint returned ok=true on port 3006 with version 0.8.3 and runtime protocol nc03-local-runtime/v5.

A browser transport regression was discovered during the recovery drill: browser-native fetch had been moved behind NC03ControlClient without preserving its receiver; this was fixed at the application boundary rather than patched in the Login screen.
After the transport fix and cache rotation, the user returned to the live Home dashboard and real modem telemetry resumed.
Live post-recovery Home evidence showed battery, connection state, signal quality, mobile network and device count updating from the modem.
